notices.syncStarted: Sync started. This can take a few minutes.

errors.exists: This CID already has a connection.
errors.cid_taken: This CID belongs to another organization.
errors.invalid_cid: A CID has 32 hexadecimal characters (0-9, a-f).
errors.invalid_base_url: Use an official CrowdStrike API URL, for example https://api.us-2.crowdstrike.com.
errors.confirm_cid: The CID you typed does not match.
errors.confirm_name: The name you typed does not match.
errors.chat_taken: This room already belongs to another organization or to the SOC team.
errors.invalid_chat: A room ID may only contain letters, digits, - and _ (5 to 64 characters).
errors.no_cids: Add a CrowdStrike connection to this organization first.
errors.no_shared: There is no shared connection to move.

test.okLogin: Login works. Add the CID to also check that it can be read.
test.okRead: Login works and this CID can be read ({count} findings found).
test.invalid_credentials: Wrong Client ID or Client Secret, or the wrong cloud. Check them and try again.
test.missing_scope: Login works, but this API client cannot read this CID. Give it the scope "Spotlight Vulnerabilities: Read" and check the CID.
test.unreachable: Could not reach CrowdStrike. Check the cloud and the network.
test.error: CrowdStrike returned an unexpected error. Try again later.

wizard.done: Organization created. You can keep adjusting it here.

org.title: Name the organization
org.help: Step 1 of 3. Only the name now. CrowdStrike and LINE come next, and you can skip them.
org.name: Organization name
org.nameHelp: The name users see. You can rename it later.

falcon.title: Connect CrowdStrike
falcon.help: Step 2 of 3. The API client of this organization's Falcon and the CID to read. Each value has its own box.
falcon.savedSync: CrowdStrike saved and reading its data now.

line.title: Set up LINE
line.help: Step 3 of 3. News sources and the groups that receive notifications. Both can have several rooms.

falcon.title: CrowdStrike
falcon.help: Each connection is one Falcon API client reading one CID. An organization can have several.
falcon.name: Connection name (optional)
falcon.customHelp: Only for a non-standard cloud. It must be an https address.
falcon.secretKeep: Never shown again. Leave empty to keep the saved secret.
falcon.secretHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
falcon.cidInvalid: A CID has exactly 32 hexadecimal characters (0-9, a-f).
falcon.cidFixed: The CID cannot be changed. Remove the connection and add it again to change it.
falcon.cidHelp: 32 hexadecimal characters, lower case. Found in Falcon under Host setup and management.
falcon.removeWarn: Removing this connection also deletes the data already read for this CID (findings, devices, software). This cannot be undone.
falcon.adopted: {count, plural, one {# CID} other {# CIDs}} moved to this organization.
falcon.addedSync: Connection saved and reading its data now.
falcon.none: This organization has no CrowdStrike connection yet. Add one to read its data.
falcon.sharedHelp: These CIDs are still read with the one shared login. Move them to this organization so they can be changed separately.
falcon.noShared: The shared login is no longer saved, so these CIDs cannot be moved. Add a connection for each instead.

line.title: LINE
line.help: News sources and notification groups are separate lists. Save them together.

sources.title: News sources
sources.help: LINE rooms that send news to the bot to read (checked against this organization's devices only).

destinations.title: Notification groups
destinations.help: LINE rooms where the bot sends CVE results for this organization (several groups allowed).

line.name: Room name
line.invalid: A room ID is 5 to 64 characters: letters, digits, - and _.
line.duplicate: This room is already in the list.
line.fallback: With no notification group, the bot replies in the room the news came from.
line.hint: To find a room ID, add the bot to the group and type /chatid there. The bot answers with the ID.

data.title: Users and data
data.help: Who can sign in to this organization and how its data is doing.
